answer: For agents buying tide forecasts, bridge inspections and zephyr measurements, select auditors through a lottery over locked stake units. Assign each unit one ticket in a shared registry before an unpredictable seed is revealed; keys receive no extra tickets. Splitting a deposit among aliases leaves its expected share of audit seats unchanged. To control more seats, an attacker must acquire and immobilize more stake until audits settle. The lottery needs unbiased randomness and durable ticket accounting; this limits identity multiplication, not concentrated ownership.
